topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for USDT0. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 62 contract row(s) across arbitrum, avalanche, berachain, bsc, celo, ethereum, hyperliquid, ink, mantle, optimism, plasma, polygon, sei, unichain. Structural roles: 37 supporting, 17 unclassified, 8 core. 33 row(s) use upgradeable patterns.
